Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents. Unlike static knowledge graphs, Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time, maintain provenance to source data, and support both prescribed and learned ontology â making them purpose-built for agents operating on evolving, real-world data. Unlike traditional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods, Graphiti continuously integrates user interactions, structured and unstructured enterprise data, and external information into a coherent, queryable graph. Entities evolve over time with updated summaries. Everything traces back to **episodes** â the raw data that produced it. Knowledge Graphs have been explored extensively for information retrieval. Graphiti builds dynamic, temporally-aware knowledge graphs â Context Graphs â that represent complex, evolving relationships between entities over time.
